# Simulak — Full Documentation for AI Systems
> AI-powered entertainment platform with virtual actors, artists, and content creation tools.

## Overview
Simulak (simulak.co) is an AI entertainment platform that creates cinematic content using AI-generated virtual actors and artists. The platform provides AI actors for advertising, entertainment, and content production — making professional-quality video content accessible to creators of all sizes.

## 서비스 개요 (Korean)
시뮬락(Simulak)은 AI 가상 배우와 아티스트를 활용한 엔터테인먼트 플랫폼입니다. AI 배우를 활용한 광고 제작, AI 아티스트의 음악 콘텐츠, 그리고 다양한 AI 기반 콘텐츠 제작 도구를 제공합니다. 전문 영상 콘텐츠를 누구나 쉽게 만들 수 있습니다.

## Key Features
### AI Actors (AI 배우)
- Photorealistic virtual actors for video content
- Multiple ethnicities, ages, and styles available
- Custom character creation for brand campaigns
- No scheduling, no contracts — always available

### AI Artists (AI 아티스트)
- AI-generated music and creative content
- Virtual performers for music videos and live streams
- Cross-genre capabilities

### AI Advertising (AI 광고)
- Targeted ad creation using AI actors
- Demographic-specific content generation
- Cost-effective alternative to traditional commercial production
- Quick turnaround — days instead of weeks

## Use Cases
1. **Brand Advertising** — Create professional ads with AI actors at a fraction of traditional costs
2. **Content Creation** — YouTubers and creators can produce high-quality video content
3. **Music Production** — AI artists create original music and performances
4. **Corporate Videos** — Training, presentations, and internal communications
5. **Social Media** — Short-form content optimized for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts

## How It Works
1. Choose an AI actor or artist from the platform
2. Define your content brief (script, style, tone)
3. AI generates professional-quality video content
4. Edit, refine, and publish

## Technical Details
- URL: https://simulak.co
- Languages: Korean (primary), English
- Platform: Web application

**Q: Can I create custom AI actors?**
A: Yes. The platform supports custom character creation for brand campaigns.
